eiffel-tower.name: Eiffel Tower
eiffel-tower.certainty: Total structure, about 11,100 US tons (10,100 tonnes). The iron frame alone is about 7,300 tonnes.
eiffel-tower.source: TODO verify: figure carried over from the prototype (operator's published total weight).

blue-whale.name: blue whale
blue-whale.certainty: Large adult, about 165 US tons. Adults vary a lot, so this is the high end rather than a strict average.
blue-whale.source: TODO verify: figure carried over from the prototype.

horse.name: horse
horse.certainty: Average riding horse. Breeds range from about 900 to 1,300 lb; draft horses are far heavier.
horse.source: PetMD, 'How Much Does a Horse Weigh?': average adult horse about 1,100 lb (500 kg). https://www.petmd.com/horse/how-much-does-a-horse-weigh

adult-human.name: adult human
adult-human.certainty: Midpoint of the US averages for men (199.0 lb) and women (171.8 lb), adults 20 and over.
adult-human.source: CDC NHANES 2021-2023 figures as reported by secondary sites; not yet checked on cdc.gov itself. The 2015-2016 CDC release gave 198 and 171 lb.

trojan-horse.name: Trojan Horse with 30 soldiers inside
trojan-horse.certainty: OUR ESTIMATE, good to about 2x. No ancient source gives a weight. Soldiers: 30 men at about 150 lb plus 50 lb of bronze armor and weapons = 6,000 lb. Horse: a belly about 25 x 8 x 8 ft to hold them, planked in 3 in fir (about 33 lb per cubic foot) is roughly 7,500 lb; doubled for frame, legs, neck, head and wheeled base = about 20,000 lb.
trojan-horse.source: Crew size: Quintus Smyrnaeus (Posthomerica 12) names about 30 and says there were more; Apollodorus gives 50; Tzetzes 23. Primary texts not checked directly. https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Trojan_Horse

mosasaurus.name: mosasaurus
mosasaurus.certainty: Estimate for a large Mosasaurus hoffmannii: about 10 tonnes (11 US tons). Bones only, so uncertain; popular sites quote 15 to 20 tons based on older, disputed length estimates.
mosasaurus.source: Natural History Museum London, 'What is a mosasaur?' (around 10 tonnes); Fanti et al. 2014 as cited on Wikipedia (10 metric tons). https://www.nhm.ac.uk/discover/what-is-a-mosasaur.html

dodo.name: dodo
dodo.certainty: Estimate: mean of about 12 kg from the largest bone sample. Other studies give 10 to 14 kg; old accounts of 50 lb birds are now thought exaggerated.
dodo.source: van Heteren et al. 2017, PeerJ, 'Neither slim nor fat' (mean about 12 kg); Angst et al. 2011 (10.2 kg). https://peerj.com/articles/4110

gigantopithecus.name: Gigantopithecus
gigantopithecus.certainty: Estimate from teeth and jaws only: 200 to 300 kg (440 to 660 lb), midpoint used. Height is disputed, from about 6 ft to 10 ft or more.
gigantopithecus.source: UCL, 'Gigantopithecus blacki: the story so far' (200-300 kg); Guinness World Records, largest primate ever (up to 280-300 kg). https://www.ucl.ac.uk/human-evolution/news/2017/mar/gigantopithecus-blacki-story-so-far

chicken-heart.name: chicken heart
chicken-heart.certainty: About 14 g, the heart of a market-age broiler (roughly 0.5 to 0.6% of a 2.2 to 2.5 kg bird). Small or young birds are 4 to 7 g, so the pair's answer is loose.
chicken-heart.source: Control groups in two broiler studies: 14.1 g at 42 days (PMC7142820) and 13.4 g at 35 days (PMC6533759).

boeing-747.name: fully loaded Boeing 747
boeing-747.certainty: Maximum takeoff weight of a standard 747-400. Empty it is about 395,000 to 412,000 lb depending on configuration; usable fuel is about 54,000 gallons (roughly 360,000 lb).
boeing-747.source: Boeing figures as relayed by aerocorner.com and aerospaceweb.org; not yet checked against Boeing's airplane characteristics document. https://aerospaceweb.org/aircraft/jetliner/b747

hummingbird.name: hummingbird
hummingbird.certainty: Ruby-throated hummingbird, about 3.4 g (males about 3 g, females about 3.5 g). They nearly double in weight before migrating.
hummingbird.source: Audubon, '10 Fun Facts About the Ruby-throated Hummingbird'; Journey North weight tables (3.1 to 3.8 g). https://www.audubon.org/magazine/10-fun-facts-about-ruby-throated-hummingbird
